MATCH (a:Artifact:Jar) WHERE a.fileName IN ['/managed-ledger-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-broker-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-broker-common-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-client-api-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-client-original-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-common-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-metadata-4.2.5.jar']
MATCH (a)-[:CONTAINS]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn STARTS WITH 'org.apache.pulsar.' AND NOT t.fqn CONTAINS '$'
WITH collect(t) AS targets
MATCH (a2:Artifact:Jar) WHERE a2.fileName IN ['/managed-ledger-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-broker-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-broker-common-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-client-api-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-client-original-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-common-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-metadata-4.2.5.jar']
MATCH (a2)-[:CONTAINS]->(s:Type)
WITH targets, collect(s) AS srcs
UNWIND targets AS t
MATCH (s)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(t) WHERE s IN srcs AND s <> t AND NOT (s.fqn STARTS WITH t.fqn + '$')
RETURN t.fqn, count(DISTINCT s) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 12
